About

About WebPerformance Report

WebPerformance Report is a reporting service. It gathers data from the tools you already trust and turns it into a clear report delivered to your inbox, on your schedule. Free to start, no dashboard to keep checking.

The Web Performance Report tests each page and covers Core Web Vitals from the lab and from real users, optimization grades, Lighthouse scores and a content breakdown, plus an AI Insight that explains what changed since the last delivery.

See the performance report

Where the data comes from

Catchpoint ensures Internet Resilience for delivering superior customer and employee digital experiences. Its Internet Performance Monitoring gives deep visibility into every layer of the Internet, BGP, DNS, SASE, CDN and WAN, so issues surface before they reach your business.

Trusted by Forbes’ top digital companies, global retailers and leading CDNs.
